mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS declines below 4.0%, or the 20d returns are not significantly higher than a baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS remains above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite UNRATE exceeding 3.5% for > 50% of triggered instances, or the 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both consumer demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase by > 2% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative despite both GDPC1 and INDPRO rising >2% in the same month, or the 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the proxies meet the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, raising long-term interest rates and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% for > 60% of triggered instances, or the 5d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs in a month triggers reduced corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative despite PAYEMS falling below 150 for > 70% of triggered instances, or the 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS crosses below 150.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand (GDPC1) coupled with declining federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable environment for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 3% while FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative despite the combined GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS movement meeting the trigger, or the 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the proxies align as specified.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO) alongside controlled inflation (CPIAUCSL < 3%) signals a healthy supply-demand balance, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 5% while CPIAUCSL remains below 3.0 in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns remain negative despite INDPRO rising >5% and CPIAUCSL staying below 3.0 for > 80% of triggered instances, or the 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when the proxies meet the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by near-zero federal funds rates and low unemployment, persistent declines in FEDFUNDS below 1% and UNRATE below 2% signal maximum accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and UNRATE < 2% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to be significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over 60d periods when FEDFUNDS and UNRATE meet the trigger, or the returns are not higher than a baseline during such regimes.
